findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 45 mm is observed in the body of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric vein, suggesting potential invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. Stenosis of the splenic artery is noted, raising suspicion of invasion. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are found in four nodes at station 8a. No other metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH0 (no invasion of the common hepatic artery)
DU0 (no invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum)
S1 (serosal invasion)
RP1 (retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV0 (no invasion of the portal vein)
A1 (stenosis of the splenic artery, suggesting potential invasion)
PL0 (no invasion of the pancreatic duct)
OO1 (contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric vein, suggesting potential invasion)

Task 2: Determine the classification for local invasion (T classification) of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the local invasion factors, the tumor is classified as T3, as it has invaded the retropancreatic tissue and has contact of more than 180° with the superior mesenteric vein.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer are defined as follows:
- Head: stations 12a, 12b, 12c, 12d, 12l
- Body and tail: stations 8a, 8b, 8p

The patient's metastatic lymph node stations are regional (station 8a). Counting only the metastatic lymph nodes within the regional stations, there are 4 metastatic lymph nodes.

N classification: N1a (4 regional lymph nodes involved)

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

No distant metastases are observed, so the M classification is M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the results of Task 1 and Task 4, the tumor is resectable (R), as there are no criteria for Borderline Resectable (BR) or Unresectable (UR).

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

Based on the determined T (T3), N (N1a), and M (M0) categories, the overall stage is Stage IIA.
